name: Tremors of the Earth
summary: Garek has concluded that Blacklash and Hematus cannot be trusted to stay in their prison at Lethlor. Black dragons have moved in there and ogres took the Sign of the Earth, so Garek sends you to free the drakes and kill them.

sections.title: A Prison Failing
sections.body: Garek can no longer be sure Blacklash and Hematus will stay imprisoned. Black dragons now dwell at Lethlor, and ogres have made off with the Sign of the Earth. Garek judges that something harsher is needed, and the drakes must die.

sections.title: Breaking the Seal
sections.body: Three runestones keep the drakes locked away, and only the Sign of the Earth can fetch them. You use the Sign on the Pillars of Amethyst, Opal and Diamond, then set the runestones into the Seal of the Earth. That frees the pair, and you slay them. Garek wants back Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus and the Sign of the Earth.

sections.title: After the Deed
sections.body: Once the drakes are dead, Garek declares that the Kirin Tor can stop fretting over Lethlor's prisoners. Garek means to report success to a master, Krasus, who will surely be pleased.

faq.answer: Drakes held prisoner in Lethlor, behind a seal.

faq.q: Why must the drakes be killed instead of kept locked away?
faq.answer: Garek can no longer be sure they will stay imprisoned. Black dragons now live at Lethlor, and ogres took the Sign of the Earth.

aliases: how to open seal of the earth
how to break the drakes out
faq.answer: Three runestones are taken from the pillars with the Sign of the Earth, then placed in the Seal of the Earth.

faq.q: What must be brought back to Garek?
faq.answer: Three things go back to Garek: Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus and the Sign of the Earth, each from a different pillar.

aliases: prerequisite for tremors of the earth
faq.answer: It follows the earlier Tremors of the Earth.

angles.text: Garek's request is one for the Alliance.
